title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Zensar is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. Zensar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for persons with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired.


Zensar does not facilitate/sponsor any work authorization for this position. All candidates must present valid authorization to commence new employment in the country for Zensar.

Candidates who are currently employed by a client or vendor of Zensar may be ineligible for consideration.

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.

title: Coordenador de Analytics  - Prevenção a Fraudes
description:
Um pouco sobre nós:


A TotalPass é uma empresa que oferece benefícios corporativos para o bem estar, proporcionando acesso à diversos serviços como academias, estúdios especializados em corrida, boxe, yoga, ciclismo, treinos funcionais coletivos e desenvolvimento muscular. Temos prazer em descomplicar a vida dos nossos clientes com as nossas soluções e fazemos isso de uma forma colaborativa, em um ambiente desafiador.

Acreditamos que o bem-estar existe quando olhamos para a saúde física e mental de maneira leve, livre e integral, e ampliamos diariamente nosso olhar para entender diferentes frentes de saúde agindo juntas. Tudo isso para que as pessoas se sintam seguras em um ambiente onde é possível equilibrar o físico e o mental, de acordo com as possibilidades de suas próprias rotinas.


Como é o time de Dados em Prevenção a Fraude?


Nosso time de Dados em Prevenção a Fraude atua de maneira analítica observando padrões e comportamentos para manter nosso aplicativo cada vez mais seguro. Hoje tem participação expressiva nos resultados da área de tecnologia. Trabalhamos em um ambiente que valoriza a comunicação aberta, a inovação e o desenvolvimento contínuo.


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Coordenar uma equipe multidisciplinar de cientistas e analistas de dados voltada para a prevenção e combate a fraudes;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, a implementação e a manutenção de modelos de machine learning e algoritmos preditivos para identificação de comportamentos suspeitos;
  • Supervisionar a construção e otimização de dashboards, relatórios e KPIs para monitoramento contínuo de fraudes e riscos operacionais;
  • Garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e desempenho das soluções analíticas desenvolvidas;
  • Facilitar a integração dos modelos e indicadores às plataformas internas (com foco em ambientes de nuvem como AWS);
  • Atuar como ponte entre a equipe técnica e as áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Propor e liderar iniciativas de inovação e melhoria contínua na área de dados aplicada à prevenção a fraudes;
  • Fomentar uma cultura de dados, promovendo boas práticas e capacitação contínua da equipe;
  • Garantir a governança e documentação dos modelos e processos analíticos implementados.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Experiência sólida com gestão de times de dados (analytics, data science, BI ou similares);
  • Conhecimento profundo em linguagens como Python e SQL;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e aplicação de modelos de machine learning para detecção de fraudes ou problemas similares;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e suas ferramentas de dados (ex: S3, Glue, Redshift, SageMaker, Athena, etc.);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, etc.);
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados, boas práticas de versionamento de código e deploy de modelos;


Formação acadêmica:


  • Formação superior em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou similares;
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou certificações em Data Science, Machine Learning ou áreas correlatas.


O que oferecemos?


  • Regime de contratação CLT;
  • Assistência Médica | Bradesco Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica | Amil Saúde;
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação | Swile Benefícios Flexíveis;
  • Plano TP7 TotalPass (+ inclusão de 10 dependentes) | Acesso aos serviços incluindo as academias do grupo Bio Ritmo, Smartfit e Queima Diária;
  • TP Clube | Clube de descontos com marcas incríveis;
  • Serviço de Saúde Mental | Parceria Psicologia Viva e Zen;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível | Modelo Remoto;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PLR Semestral;
  • Total Learn (reembolso para cursos rápidos, livros e cursos de idiomas);
  • Descontos em universidades parceiras (Graduação, Pós, MBA);
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Auxílio Creche.

title: Senior Functional Consultant – Coupa / Procurement SaaS (Remote)
description:
Job Opportunity – Sr. Functional Consultant / Sr. Software Implementation Consultant – Ref. 10242

Location: Remote (with occasional travel)

Contract Type: Services agreement / Full-time

Languages: Fluent Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus)

We’re looking for a Senior Functional Consultant with proven experience in implementing SaaS solutions in the spend management or procurement space. This role is instrumental in leading the functional design, guiding successful implementations, and ensuring long-term client success across strategic digital transformation projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead functional design during implementation projects, acting as a subject matter expert.
  • Facilitate customer design workshops and advise on best practices for system configuration and process optimization.
  • Support design review sessions and collaborate with product teams on solution enhancements.
  • Provide expert guidance on supplier management, sourcing, and contract lifecycle management (CLM) solutions.
  • Work closely with external partners and internal stakeholders to drive value and adoption.

Ideal Profile:

  • Strong background in SaaS consulting, particularly in procurement or spend management solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with supplier information management and/or eSourcing platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) tools is highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to manage clients and lead successful implementations.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP
description:
SAP ABAP SR - Remoto

2 meses - podendo prorrogar

PJ


Você será parte de uma equipe que valoriza a inovação e a colaboração, com um compromisso em fornecer soluções de alta qualidade para nossos clientes.



Sobre o Papel


Estamos em busca de um profissional SAP ABAP Sênior com experiência significativa para atender demandas de forma remota.



Requisitos


  • Experiência em projetos com os módulos SAP: SD, MM, FI, CO, MM e WM.
  • Performance Tuning com conhecimento avançado das melhores práticas SAP.
  • Report ALV;
  • ABAP Orientado a Objetos;
  • Module Pool e ALV interativo e editável;
  • Formulário (Smartforms e Etiqueta para impressora térmica ZEBRA “linguagem ZPL”);
  • ABAP Proxy;
  • Módulo de Funções normal ou RFC;
  • Processamento em JOB, utilizando BAPI e Call transaction;
  • Processamento em BACKGROUND TASK, UPDATE TASK e Paralelismo;
  • Enhancements SAP (BADI, User-exit, Screen-exit, Enhancement-Point, Fórmulas Pricing em SD e MM, Regra de substituição e validação em FI e Evento BTE);
  • Função de Perfil (Role) e Objeto de autorização;
  • Dicionário de dados completo (Tabelas, estruturas, índices de tabelas, Search-Help, elemento de dados e domínio);
  • Diálogo de atualização com tabela e visão;
  • Técnicas de análises do ambiente SAP assim como: Lock Table, Enqueue/Dequeue, Tabelas de LOGs standard, análise de JOBs, análise de Tasks/Workprocess (Transações SM50, SM51, SM66) e performance.
  • SAP Workflow.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Análise de Sistemas, Segurança da Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou outros cursos correlatos.


Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades


Estamos comprometidos com a diversidade e a inclusão em nosso local de trabalho. Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional ou deficiência.

title: Closer | Negociador
description:
Somos a ReAsset:


Identificamos, provemos solução estratégica e de capital e operamos investimentos em ativos estressados, recuperando sua liquidez e os devolvendo ao mercado para que produzam seu máximo valor.


Buscamos Negociador | Closer para compor o time Comercial.


Atividades:


  • Conduzir negociações, apresentando a proposta da empresa, esclarecendo dúvidas e fechando negócios .
  • Atuar sobre oportunidades qualificadas (repasse do time SDR) e listas pré-qualificadas realizando contatos por telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp.
  • Tratar objeções com comunicação clara e escuta ativa , garantindo segurança e aderência às políticas internas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times SDR/Comercial, Marketing e Inteligência, buscando e compartilhando aprendizados sobre produtos e clientes para calibrar argumentos e aprimorar continuamente os roteiros.
  • Manter o CRM e demais sistemas atualizados , registrando status, próximos passos e histórico dos atendimentos.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas/fechamento (inside sales ou similar).
  • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para contato claro e eficaz com os clientes.
  • Capacidade de escuta ativa e entendimento das necessidades do cliente.
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de CRM e pacote Office.
  • Perfil proativo , dinâmico e com foco em resultados .
  • Conhecimento jurídico será considerado um diferencial.


Trabalho 100% Home Office – Contratação PJ

Remuneração: Fixo + Comissão (sem limite de ganhos)

title: Consultor de vendas internas
description:
Sobre o time


Somos movidos pelo propósito de preservar vidas no trânsito por meio da nossa tecnologia!

No time Comercial Inside , nossa missão é levar as soluções da Golfleet para grandes frotas em todo o Brasil, mostrando aos gestores de frotas, que ainda não são nossos clientes, como nosso software podem transformar seus negócios, otimizando recursos, promovendo sustentabilidade e, claro, aumentando a segurança dos seus condutores.



Como será o seu dia a dia


  • Realizar vendas internas , conectando-se com empresas que possuem frotas de até 100 veículos.
  • Fazer reuniões online com prospects.
  • Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes e oportunidades no PIPE.
  • Ter proatividade em todas as etapas da jornada do cliente.
  • Fazer prospecção inteligente , estudando o segmento antes de abordar.
  • Conduzir vendas consultivas , com foco em relacionamento e negociação estratégica.



O que buscamos em você


  • Experiência em vendas consultivas (de preferência em soluções B2B).
  • Sede de aprender e se tornar especialista em tecnologia para gestão de frotas.



O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissão sem teto (CLT).
  • Bônus por produtividade + campanhas de vendas.
  • Vale Alimentação (cartão Flash).
  • Plano de saúde com mensalidade 100% pago pela Golfleet (para você e dependentes).
  • Plano odontológico nacional (para você e dependentes).
  • Saúde e Bem-Estar : crédito mensal no cartão Flash para consultas, atividades físicas, terapias e farmácia.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados anual (PLR).
  • UnicoSkill – acesso a cursos de graduação, pós, idiomas e mentorias.
  • Incentivo ao PGF e MBA Executivo em Gestão de Frotas (Instituto PARAR).
  • Day off no aniversário.
  • Benefícios especiais para sua família como Quem Casa Quer Casa, Vem Neném e Volta às Aulas.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.
  • Licença luto ampliada.
  • E ainda: equipamento Golfleet gratuito.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Product Manager
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Senior experience: 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Req English)
description:
3thix
Remote-First (Global) | Full-Time
About 3thix
3thix is a next-generation fintech platform bridging traditional payments with blockchain rails. We power seamless, low-cost, and compliant transfers using stable tokens, smart contracts, and hybrid on/off-ramp infrastructure. Backed by top-tier VCs, we process millions in daily volume and are expanding into new corridors and asset classes.
The Role
We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in fintech payment systems, blockchain protocols, and stable token ecosystems (USDC, USDT, EURC, etc.). You’ll design, build, and scale the core transaction engine that routes fiat ↔ crypto, settles on-chain, and ensures regulatory compliance at every step.
What You’ll Do
Architect and maintain high-throughput payment orchestration services handling fiat deposits, crypto swaps, stable token mint/burn, and instant settlements.
Build reconciliation systems that sync on-chain events (EVM, Solana, Stellar) with off-chain ledgers and banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, SPEI).
Implement risk, fraud, and AML controls in real-time transaction pipelines.
Design idempotent, event-driven microservices using Kafka / Pulsar and domain-driven patterns.
Own blockchain node infrastructure (Geth, Solana RPC, custom indexers) and write secure smart-contract interaction layers.
Scale systems to 10k+ TPS with sub-100ms latency for cross-border flows.
Collaborate with compliance and product teams to embed KYC/KYT, travel-rule data, and sanction screening.
Lead incident response for payment disputes, rollbacks, and chain re-orgs.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years backend engineering in high-scale environments.
Production experience in fintech / payments (acquiring, issuing, remittance, or payout systems).
Deep blockchain knowledge:
EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum)
Stable token standards (ERC-20, SPL, CCTP)
MEV, gas optimization, and on-chain data indexing (The Graph, Dune, custom subsql)
Mastery of Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node.js (we primarily use Go).
Event sourcing, CQRS, and distributed transaction patterns.
Secure handling of HSMs, key management (KMS, MPC), and cryptographic signing.
Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK.
Experience with regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOC2, PSD2, FinCEN travel rule).
Nice-to-Have
Built or audited stablecoin issuance/redemption systems.
Contributed to open-source blockchain tooling or payment protocols.
Worked with layer-2 networks (Optimism, Base, zkSync) or cross-chain bridges.
Familiarity with ISO 20022, FedNow, or RTP rails.
Tech Stack
Core: Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
Blockchain: Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers.js, viem, Solana SDK
Infra: Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP/AWS, Grafana Tempo
Security: HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Fireblocks MPC
Why Join 3thix
Equity in a rocket-ship startup.
Unlimited PTO + global off-sites.
Top-tier health, dental, and remote workspace stipend.
Work directly with ex-Stripe, Circle, and Coinbase engineers.
Shape the future of programmable money.

Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Software Engineer GENEXUS
description:
We are Bizmoni the Next Gen AI Super APP


Our genuine and passionate global business culture is 100% remote and fully cloud based with 60 team members, and spread out over more than 20 countries.


THIS IS YOUR CHANCE TO BECOME A CO CO-FOUNDER IN THE NEXT GLOBAL UNICORN!


If are skilled, a doer by nature, hands-on, self-motivated, disciplined, focused, and above all result driven and a demonstrated team player we want to meet you.


What we expect


  • You are a passionate and responsible person, flexible, and result driven.
  • YOU ARE A PUNCTUAL PERSON, IF NOT, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.
  • Conversational English and maybe proficient in Spanish and or Portuguese is a big plus but not a must.
  • You are organized and out-of-the-box problem solver, spontaneous, creative, and able to go straight to the point.
  • You are disciplined and able to work remotely, IF YOU ARE NOT PLEASE CO NOT APPLY
  • You are eager to reach goals and make things happen.
  • You have a Personal Computer with a Camera and a stable and reliable internet connection.
  • You love to move up your sleeves and get things done.
  • You are social and ethically responsible.
  • You understand that the new money is EQUITY, and you have the drive to build a Business with others, IF THIS IS NOT THE CASE PLEASE DO NOT APPLY
  • You are open to take Risks
  • You commit for 8 hours per week up to a possible 16 hours


Job Qualifications:


  • Experienced SENIOR GENEXUS developer
  • Writing clean, high-quality, high-performance, maintainable code
  • Develop and support software including applications, database integration, interfaces, and new functionality enhancements
  • Coordinate cross-functionally to insure project meets business objectives and compliance standards
  • Support test and deployment of new products and features
  • Participate in code reviews


Job Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field)
  • Experience in using GENEXUS .NET and .NET native development
  • Expertise in Object Oriented Design, Database Design, and XML Schema
  • Experience with Agile or Scrum software development methodologies
  • Ability to multi-task, organize, and prioritize work
  • +5 years work experience
  • Proficient in English or Spanish or both, Portuguese is a plus.


If you meet the requirements and looking for a flexible, futuristic organization where talent is admired and you are eager to become a CO FOUNDER here is your opportunity and we can't wait to meet you.

title: Data Migration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Migration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract hybrid or remote.


In this role you will:

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Data Migration and Transformation: Design and implement data migration processes. Develop scripts, ETL processes ( Extract, Transform, Load) and tools for data migration, adapted to the specific requirements of the project. Utilize SQL, data mapping, and transformation techniques to optimize efficiency.
  • Data Integrity and Quality: Ensure data integrity and validation during the migration process. Perform regular audits and validation checks to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT) and adjust the migration approach as needed.
  • Project and Risk Management: Plan and manage data migration projects, including resource allocation and schedule management. Identify and mitigate the risks associated with data migration, developing proactive strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring that data migration processes comply with industry standards and regulations. Adhere to organizational policies and procedures.
  • Documentation and Communication: Generate regular progress reports for stakeholders. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data migration activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and knowledge sharing.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in data migration and management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Technical Tools and Skills:
  • Proficiency in SQL and data migration tools like Talend, Informatica .
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.
  • Advanced English and/or French.

Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: Certification in data management (e.g., CDMP) or advanced certifications in data migration tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica ).
  • Knowledge: Experience with data migration to the cloud (AWS, Azure ). Familiarity with agile project management methodologies. Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations.

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

title: Gerente de ERP e Transformação Digital
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de ERP e Transformação Digital para uma empresa localizada em São Paulo/SP.


Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!


Objetivo da posição:

Será responsável por liderar a transformação digital do Grupo, com foco na migração e implantação de um novo ERP e na integração das unidades no Brasil, México, Colômbia e futuras operações internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o plano diretor de tecnologia e alinhar TI à estratégia “Grupo 2030”;
  • Conduzir o processo de seleção e implantação do ERP, do diagnóstico ao pós-go-live;
  • Promover governança tecnológica, segurança da informação e compliance digital;
  • Estruturar padrões e sistemas unificados para operações internacionais;
  • Gerir infraestrutura, contratos e equipe interna/externa de TI;
  • Atuar como agente estratégico de transformação digital com visão de eficiência e crescimento.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em posições de liderança em TI, com histórico comprovado de implantação de ERP de grande porte (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS Protheus/RM, etc.).
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração de infraestrutura tecnológica, seja em transição para nuvem, ambientes híbridos ou reestruturações locais.
  • Vivência no setor industrial, preferencialmente em grupos com unidades produtivas e atuação internacional.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de soluções para manufatura, supply chain e engenharia (ex: integração de ERP com PLM, WMS, CRM, BI, manutenção, etc.) será considerado um diferencial relevante.
  • Espanhol desejável


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

Para mais informações, acesse o site:

  • Atuar como agente estratégico de transformação digital com visão de eficiência e crescimento.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em posições de liderança em TI, com histórico comprovado de implantação de ERP de grande porte (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS Protheus/RM, etc.).
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração de infraestrutura tecnológica, seja em transição para nuvem, ambientes híbridos ou reestruturações locais.
  • Vivência no setor industrial, preferencialmente em grupos com unidades produtivas e atuação internacional.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de soluções para manufatura, supply chain e engenharia (ex: integração de ERP com PLM, WMS, CRM, BI, manutenção, etc.) será considerado um diferencial relevante.
  • Espanhol desejável


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!


O que buscamos:

A Worldpanel está em busca de um(a) Analista de Pesquisa de Mercado Sênior com interesse genuíno em entender o comportamento do consumidor e transformar dados em insights que orientem decisões estratégicas. Se você tem espírito investigativo, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de trabalhar com dados e pessoas, essa vaga pode ser para você!


As responsabilidades incluem:

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, especialmente o time comercial;
  • Receber, analisar e criticar briefings, produzindo materiais alinhados às demandas;
  • Atuar em atividades de maior complexidade e interagir com stakeholders seniores;
  • Participar, quando possível, das apresentações para clientes;
  • Diagnosticar oportunidades de negócio nos clientes para abordagem comercial;
  • Produzir insights adicionais que possam gerar novas oportunidades;
  • Participar de reuniões de briefing com clientes, se necessário;
  • Sintetizar informações, construir storytelling com dados e comunicar-se bem com diferentes públicos;
  • Cumprir os prazos estabelecidos no cronograma de entregas (SLA e priorizações).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em análise de mercado, comportamento do consumidor ou inteligência de mercado;
  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Comunicação, Estatística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pensamento analítico, visão estratégica, autonomia, organização e proatividade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em pacote Office;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e habilidades para resolver problemas;
  • Inglês avançado (desejável espanhol intermediário);
  • Conhecimento na plataforma Jira será considerado diferencial.


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Horário Flexível;
  • Home-office;
  • Programa Qualidade de Vida: Totalpass, participação em corridas, vacinação contra gripe, palestras sobre temas relevantes e muito mais;
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna – a Worldpanel valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Especialista - Java/Angular
description:
Desenvolvedor FullStack Especialista - Java/Angular

Missão do Cargo

Desenvolver e manter soluções de software robustas, escaláveis e seguras, aplicando as melhores práticas de engenharia, garantindo qualidade, estabilidade e evolução contínua das aplicações. Atuar na modernização tecnológica, incluindo migração de sistemas monolíticos para arquiteturas baseadas em microserviços e nuvem (AWS).

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura

Implementar soluções utilizando Java 8+ e Angular 8+, Spring Boot e padrões modernos de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal).

Projetar e desenvolver APIs RESTful com boas práticas de versionamento, segurança e escalabilidade.

Criar e manter microserviços e contribuir para a migração de sistemas monolíticos para AWS.

Qualidade, Segurança e Sustentação

Garantir código limpo, versionado (Git/GitHub) e revisado, com integração e entrega contínuas (CI/CD via GitHub Actions).

Implementar testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, TDD/BDD) e monitorar qualidade com SonarQube.

Aplicar práticas de segurança, incluindo análise de vulnerabilidades e proteção de APIs e dados sensíveis.

Realizar sustentação, correção de bugs e monitoramento de aplicações em produção.

Infraestrutura e DevOps

Trabalhar em ambientes Linux, configurando e otimizando ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção.

Utilizar serviços AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) para deploy, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, API de datas).

Angular 8+

Spring Boot (MVC, Data, Security).

APIs RESTful com boas práticas.

Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, desejável DB2).

Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Maven, SonarQube, Nexus.

Testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito).

Experiência com microserviços, arquitetura distribuída e cloud (AWS).

Conhecimentos em segurança (criptografia, certificados digitais).

Desejável: arquitetura orientada a eventos, ferramentas de transferência de arquivos (Connect Direct, XFB, CFT).

Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

Protagonismo e senso de dono nas entregas.

Colaboração e boa comunicação em squads multifuncionais.

Pensamento crítico, capacidade de propor melhorias e resolver problemas.

Adaptabilidade a mudanças e aprendizado contínuo.

Autonomia com responsabilidade e disposição para pedir ajuda quando necessário.

Formação

Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

Mínimo de 10 anos em desenvolvimento de software, preferencialmente em ambientes de missão crítica.


Modelo de Contrato

Contratação CLT


Remuneração

A Combinar.


Benefícios

VA, Convênio Médico e Odontológico, Gympass e PLR.


Modalidade de Trabalho

Remoto


Horário de Trabalho

Horário comercial, das 9h às 18h.

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Especialista - Java/Angular
description:
Desenvolvedor FullStack Especialista - Java/Angular

Missão do Cargo

Desenvolver e manter soluções de software robustas, escaláveis e seguras, aplicando as melhores práticas de engenharia, garantindo qualidade, estabilidade e evolução contínua das aplicações. Atuar na modernização tecnológica, incluindo migração de sistemas monolíticos para arquiteturas baseadas em microserviços e nuvem (AWS).

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura

Implementar soluções utilizando Java 8+ e Angular 8+, Spring Boot e padrões modernos de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal).

Projetar e desenvolver APIs RESTful com boas práticas de versionamento, segurança e escalabilidade.

Criar e manter microserviços e contribuir para a migração de sistemas monolíticos para AWS.

Qualidade, Segurança e Sustentação

Garantir código limpo, versionado (Git/GitHub) e revisado, com integração e entrega contínuas (CI/CD via GitHub Actions).

Implementar testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, TDD/BDD) e monitorar qualidade com SonarQube.

Aplicar práticas de segurança, incluindo análise de vulnerabilidades e proteção de APIs e dados sensíveis.

Realizar sustentação, correção de bugs e monitoramento de aplicações em produção.

Infraestrutura e DevOps

Trabalhar em ambientes Linux, configurando e otimizando ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção.

Utilizar serviços AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) para deploy, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, API de datas).

Angular 8+

Spring Boot (MVC, Data, Security).

APIs RESTful com boas práticas.

Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, desejável DB2).

Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Maven, SonarQube, Nexus.

Testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito).

Experiência com microserviços, arquitetura distribuída e cloud (AWS).

Conhecimentos em segurança (criptografia, certificados digitais).

Desejável: arquitetura orientada a eventos, ferramentas de transferência de arquivos (Connect Direct, XFB, CFT).

Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

Protagonismo e senso de dono nas entregas.

Colaboração e boa comunicação em squads multifuncionais.

Pensamento crítico, capacidade de propor melhorias e resolver problemas.

Adaptabilidade a mudanças e aprendizado contínuo.

Autonomia com responsabilidade e disposição para pedir ajuda quando necessário.

title: Analista de Monitoramento/BI
description:
Analista de Monitoramento e BI Sênior


Irá atuar tanto em BI quanto em monitoramento, atuando de forma mais técnica para apoiar automações e melhorias de processos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Monitoramento e análise aprofundada durante o horário comercial.
  • Identificação e classificação de temas sensíveis.
  • Desenvolvimento de automação de processos (dashboards, relatórios dinâmicos, alertas automáticos).
  • Gestão da interface técnica e metodológica com o parceiro externo.
  • Elaboração de relatórios de performance e recomendações estratégicas.

  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de monitoramento (Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Stilingue e etc.).

  • Perfil analítico, com visão estratégica e capacidade de traduzir dados em insights de negócio.


Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Assistência Médica;

title: Content Creator
description:
Somos uma marca internacional de suplementos premium.


Estamos procurando criadores que nos ajudem a tornar a marca viral e levá-la para o próximo nível.


O que você vai fazer:


- Gravar vídeos para Instagram (Reels), TikTok e YouTube (Shorts), sendo o rosto do conteúdo.

- Editar e publicar o material nas redes.

- Fazer brainstorms de ideias com o time criativo.

- Pegar tendências e dar o seu próprio toque para o negócio.

- Escrever roteiros simples para que cada vídeo tenha flow.


O que esperamos de você:


- Já ter alguma experiência criando Reels ou TikToks.

- Ter no mínimo 1.500 seguidores em qualquer rede social (se tiver mais, melhor!).

- Saber usar aplicativos de edição (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci ou o que preferir).

- Boa energia diante da câmera, criatividade e vontade de experimentar coisas novas.

- Se tiver seu próprio kit (iPhone 12 ou superior, ring light, microfone), é um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:


- Contas novas nas redes para você criar seu próprio espaço.

- Suplementos gratuitos + todas as informações sobre cada produto.

- Apoio constante: ideias, tendências, feedback e muita liberdade criativa.

- Salário fixo de BRL1500 + bônus baseado no total de visualizações.

Expectativa: gravar entre 3 e 5 vídeos por dia.


O que há para você:


- Uma empresa jovem e ambiciosa que usa IA e GPT para tirar o tédio e deixar só o que é divertido.

- Um time animado, cheio de energia e vontade de fazer acontecer.

- Um espaço real para experimentar, crescer e causar impacto.


Se você é ambicios@, criativ@ e quer crescer junto com um projeto poderoso, mande sua aplicação!


Te esperamos na entrevista online ❤️

title: Pesquisador
description:
Descrição da Função


Estamos buscando um pesquisador para trabalhar em horário integral e de forma remota, realizando pesquisas aprofundadas sobre projetos de construção e as partes envolvidas; que seja capaz de localizar as documentações relevantes relacionadas aos projetos. 



Principais Responsabilidades


Pesquisar, de maneira minuciosa, detalhes específicos de projetos de construção, identificando, por exemplo, o proprietário, contratante e contratados envolvidos e verificando endereços

Determinar o tipo de projeto (público, privado, residencial)

Fazer o envio de documentação específica necessária para garantir o fluxo adequado de pagamentos dos projetos

Realizar pesquisas com precisão e eficiência



Qualificações e Requisitos


Ser morador do estado de Minas Gerais

Alta proficiência em inglês

Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e integrando seu trabalho com a equipe

Proficiência em ferramentas de pesquisa e análise de dados

Diferencial - Bacharelado em área relevante (Ciências Sociais, Estatística, Economia e afins)

Familiaridade com documentos e processos da indústria da construção é um diferencial desejável

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: AI Engineer (NLP)
description:
We're looking for a Senior ML/AI Engineer to own and evolve our LLM-powered user experience. You'll work directly with our technical co-founder to build, optimize, and monitor agent systems that parse workout descriptions, provide scaling recommendations, and enable conversational data retrieval - all with production-grade accuracy and speed.

This is a hands-on role focused on the ML/AI engineering side: prompt engineering, model optimization, agent orchestration, and continuous improvement based on real-world usage patterns.

What You’ll Do

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the workout parsing system: improve accuracy of our fine-tuned model (currently Qwen-based) that converts natural language workout descriptions into structured schemas
  • Design and implement agent workflows for workout scaling recommendations and performance tracking
  • Build observability workflows using Langfuse to identify and systematically address model performance issues
  • Optimize agent response latency while maintaining accuracy across our tool-based reasoning system
  • Collaborate on agent architecture decisions, including potential migration to frameworks like DSPy
  • Ship production features: workout entry system, scaling recommendations, and score reporting

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of ML/AI engineering experience with at least 2 years working with LLMs in production
  • Strong prompt engineering and model optimization skills
  • Experience building and deploying agent systems with tools/functions
  • Proven ability to use observability platforms to diagnose and improve model performance
  • Experience with model fine-tuning (any framework/approach)
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Active CrossFit participant - candidates should understand standard movements and workout structures

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (DSPy, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Background in production ML operations and monitoring
  • Experience with Modal.com or similar serverless ML platforms
  • Track record of iteratively improving LLM systems based on user feedback and metrics
  • Experience fine tuning similar open-source LLMs

Success in First 6 Months

  • Ship workout entry system with improved parsing accuracy
  • Launch basic workout scaling recommendations
  • Implement user score reporting and retrieval
  • Establish robust monitoring workflows to catch and address model failures and poor user experiences
  • Contribute to agent architecture decisions as we scale

title: Customer Service Agent / Survey
description:
Company Description


Best Servicers of America is an innovative provider of on-site services solutions, dedicated to enhancing brand image and customer service experience. We offer accurate diagnostic and technical support and follow-up phone calls to ensure customer satisfaction. Our team works closely with businesses to tailor our services to meet their unique requirements, dispatching professional technicians to provide total business solutions.


Role Description


We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Billing Specialist to join our Billing Department. This role plays a key part in ensuring accuracy in service repair claims and payments. You will review completed repairs, confirm pricing, submit claims to customers, and verify technician payments. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities are essential, as this position directly impacts financial accuracy and customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review completed repair tickets to ensure all prices and charges are correct.
  • Submit claims to customers and follow up to resolve any issues.
  • Verify and process payments for technicians who completed the repairs.
  • Make phone calls in English to technicians, customers, and consumers when clarification or updates are needed.
  • Contact customers to correct claim issues and provide status updates.
  • Collaborate with the billing and operations team to support overall department efficiency.
  • Proactively identify and solve problems to avoid delays in payments or claims processing.


Qualifications


  • Previous experience in billing, claims, customer service, or a similar role (preferred but not required).
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to learn quickly and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written).
  • Proactive, problem-solving mindset with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Computer proficiency (MS Office, email, Excel).


Please read before applying:


You will be receiving an email with a DocuSign form to be completed.

Contact me on Skype. At the end of the form, there is a Skype link to contact me to schedule the interview time and date.

Only the candidates who read and complete all the steps will be interviewed.


***RESUMES MUST BE SENT IN ENGLISH ONLY***


We are looking for people who want to grow with us.


The position we have at this moment is in the Logistics Department. 


The job is from Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 or 9:00 to 18:00 (USA Eastern Standard Time). This opportunity is for someone who can work unsupervised and work from home.


The requirements are:


- Having a fast computer (minimum 8 GB of RAM) and a headset with a microphone that you can use to work (no earbuds or AirPods).

- Having high-speed internet (100mbps or faster) access at home.

- Have a quiet environment (no dogs barking, babies crying, loud music, street noises, or similar in the background).

- Two screens to start the training (will ask for pictures before the interview).


The payment is $850.00 US Dollars per month. Paid direct deposit on the 5th of each month.


We have a probationary period of 90 days, during which you will be in training, and during this period you will be receiving $700.00 US Dollars per month.

***Do not apply if your salary expectations exceed this offer, as the salary is not negotiable.


Hiring process:


LinkedIn applications will be reviewed within 48 hours of being sent.

If your profile qualifies, you'll receive an email with a DocuSign form.

Contact us via Skype to schedule the interview (the link will be inside the form)
